matches.text: 腰间系杂色短须绦，背上悬松纹古锭剑。
穿一双云头点翠早朝靴，骑一匹分鬃昂首黄花马。

scope: Only costume and mount in chapter54; no automatic approval of other chapters, combat skills or all later appearances.
explicit_facts: Chapter54 Gongsun Sheng mounted on yellow-flower horse; star crown, cloud-embroidered clothing, mixed short-fringed cord, back sword and court boots.
Mounted drawn pine-pattern sword points at enemy; a later passage points upward.
art_interpretations: Exact coat hue, saddle/bridle, crown shape, embroidery layout and drawn sword handedness.
Walking poses and timing are animation design; anatomical left/right synchronization across views is not yet qualified.
limitations: Chapter54 only, not automatic approval for chapter5 wind rite, general identity, all later costumes, skills or story outcomes.
Rear rigid gold-ended strand may be waistcord or duplicate sheath. It remains a visual ambiguity, not a proven second novel weapon. No attack phase adopted.
